channel.title: One Topic a Week
channel.description: A newsletter that sets one beginner-friendly AI topic each week and explains it like a friend would: plain English, step by step, never condescending. Written in public.

item.title: What is MCP, in plain English
item.description: Model Context Protocol sounds like buzzword soup. It is really just one idea — a standard plug for AI tools — and it clicks once you see it.

item.title: Run a small AI on your own laptop
item.description: Local AI in plain English — why it is free, private, and easier to start than you would think.
